home.introTitle: Security that feels considered, not loud.
home.introText: AGOC Security is built on trust, trained people, and an unfussy commitment to keeping sites calm. We work residential compounds, commercial towers, hotels, hospitals, warehouses, and private households — with the same standard on every post.
home.introCaption: Quiet professionals. Clear communication. No theatrics.
reasons: Coverage for homes, offices, hotels, events, and warehouses
Guards trained for commercial, medical, and residential posts

features.title: Property security
features.text: Access control, patrols, and 24/7 presence that keeps assets and people unhurried.

features.title: Surveillance
features.text: Live CCTV, alerts, and operators who actually watch — not just record.

features.title: Deep cleaning
features.text: Thorough deep cleans for kitchens, washrooms, floors, and hard-to-reach areas — one-off or scheduled when a space needs a full reset.

home.whyTitle: People first. Then process. Then tech.
home.whyText: Clients stay because the officer on the door is calm, the supervisor answers, and the report arrives. We hire for character, train for the post, and only then layer cameras and access systems.

whyItems.title: Verified staff
whyItems.text: Background checks, licensing, and briefing before anyone wears the badge.

whyItems.title: Made for the site
whyItems.text: A villa is not a nightclub. Coverage, posture, and reporting change with the brief.

whyItems.title: Always reachable
whyItems.text: A real operations line — not a voicemail maze — from Sunday through Saturday.

home.contactText: Tell us the site, the hours, and the risk. We will come back with a clear proposal — not a catalogue.
home.contactNote: A named supervisor from day one.

about.title: Protection with a human face.
about.text: We look after people, property, and assets with trained officers, modern systems, and plans written for the site — not copied from a brochure.
about.whoTitle: AGOC General Security Guard Services LLC
about.whoText1: Based in Al Muteena, Dubai, AGOC provides licensed security officers and supporting services across the UAE. Our work is straightforward: understand the risk, staff the post properly, and stay reachable.
about.whoText2: From residential compounds to hotels, hospitals, warehouses, and private households, the same standard applies — verified people, clear reporting, and technology that supports the officer rather than replacing them.
about.missionText: Our mission is to provide unparalleled security solutions that ensure the safety and peace of mind of our clients. We are dedicated to delivering professional, reliable, and innovative security services tailored to meet the unique needs of each individual or organization we serve.
about.visionText: Our vision is to be the leading provider of cutting-edge security solutions, setting the industry standard for excellence and innovation. We envision a future where safety is never compromised, and our services are trusted globally for their effectiveness, reliability, and responsiveness.
about.valuesText: Years on the ground across industries, with plans that match the building, the hours, and the people who live or work there.

values.title: Discipline
values.text: Posts run on time, in uniform, with notes that a manager can actually use.

values.title: Discretion
values.text: Private clients and premium venues need presence without spectacle.

values.title: Judgement
values.text: We hire people who can de-escalate first and act firmly when they must.

stayItems.title: Expertise
stayItems.text: Reliable coverage across commercial, residential, and event environments.

stayItems.title: Tailored plans
stayItems.text: Every site gets its own roster, SOP, and escalation path.

stayItems.title: Modern tools
stayItems.text: CCTV, access control, and monitoring used with purpose.

stayItems.title: 24/7 protection
stayItems.text: Round-the-clock posts and a live operations line.

stayItems.title: Trained officers
stayItems.text: People prepared for the post they are actually standing.

stayItems.title: Peace of mind
stayItems.text: You run the business. We keep the perimeter quiet.

about.teamText: Founder-led operations with a coordinator and officers who know the brief before they put on the badge.

team.name: Abdul Moeez Awan
team.bio: I am proud to lead AGOC with a clear focus on people, professionalism, and trust. Our teams are trained to protect what matters most to our clients — with discipline, care, and integrity every day. I remain committed to building lasting partnerships across Dubai and the UAE through reliable service and honest standards.
team.closing: Leading with Integrity. Serving with Excellence. Growing Through Trust.

team.name: Coordinator
team.bio: Coordinates rosters, site briefings, and rapid response so every post stays covered.

team.name: Training Lead
team.bio: Keeps officers sharp on procedure, de-escalation, and the standards clients expect.

team.name: Teymur Baghirzade
team.bio: Shapes AGOC’s brand presence and client-facing campaigns across Dubai and the UAE.
